objective: GATE 3F-B MPRO. Determinar exclusivamente si el historial runtime permite certificar una regla determinista de asignacion de Pc_ID dentro de cada Cxp_Folio, sin asumir que frecuencia implica autoridad. Auditar continuidad, inicio, maximo, huecos y relacion de Pc_ID con numero ordinal de pagos por folio usando solo agregados. Si no puede demostrarse una regla autoritativa segura, emitir blocker explicito y mantener canary bloqueado.

queries.name: f3b_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3b_folio_payment_count_shape
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS folios,MIN(total_pagos) AS min_pagos,MAX(total_pagos) AS max_pagos,SUM(CASE WHEN total_pagos>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS folios_multipago FROM (SELECT Cxp_Folio,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pagos FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Cxp_Folio) q

queries.name: f3b_pc_id_numeric_shape
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_numericos,MIN(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) AS min_pc_id,MAX(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) AS max_pc_id FROM dbo.Pago_CXP

queries.name: f3b_first_pc_id_by_folio
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) AS first_pc_id,COUNT_BIG(*) AS folios FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Cxp_Folio HAVING MIN(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY first_pc_id

queries.name: f3b_contiguity_summary
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS folios_total,SUM(CASE WHEN min_id=1 AND max_id=total_pagos THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS folios_contiguos_desde_1,SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (min_id=1 AND max_id=total_pagos) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS folios_no_contiguos FROM (SELECT Cxp_Folio,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pagos,MIN(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) AS min_id,MAX(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) AS max_id FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Cxp_Folio) q

queries.name: f3b_duplicate_pc_id_within_folio
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS duplicate_groups FROM (SELECT Cxp_Folio,Pc_ID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Cxp_Folio,Pc_ID HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3b_pc_id_vs_count_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT total_pagos,max_id,COUNT_BIG(*) AS folios FROM (SELECT Cxp_Folio,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pagos,MAX(TRY_CONVERT(int,Pc_ID)) AS max_id FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Cxp_Folio) q GROUP BY total_pagos,max_id ORDER BY total_pagos,max_id

queries.name: f3b_pk_shape
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') AND i.is_primary_key=1 ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: f3b_sequences
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,q.name AS sequence_name,q.current_value FROM sys.sequences q INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=q.schema_id WHERE q.name LIKE N'%Pago%' OR q.name LIKE N'%CXP%' OR q.name LIKE N'%Pc%' ORDER BY s.name,q.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider, invoice or payment business rows
Only aggregate historical patterns and metadata
Connections only through PosRuntimeResolver and get_external_sql_connection
Historical contiguity alone does not prove vendor-authoritative generation; distinguish observed deterministic pattern from authoritative mechanism
If authority is not proven, classify Pc_ID mechanism as NOT_PROVEN and keep MPRO canary blocked
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
